faqs.question: Does Acme work with Alexa and Google Home?
faqs.answer: Yes. Enable the Acme skill in the Alexa app or link Acme in Google Home under Works with Google. Matter devices can also be added directly through the Hub Pro.

faqs.question: Do I need a C-wire for the thermostat?
faqs.answer: A C-wire is recommended. If your system has no C-wire, use the Power Adapter Kit included in the box.

faqs.question: Can I share access with family members?
faqs.answer: Yes. Go to Profile > Home > Members and invite up to 10 people by email. Members can control devices but cannot change billing.

faqs.question: How do I delete my account?
faqs.answer: Go to Profile > Privacy > Delete account. Deletion is permanent after 30 days. Active subscriptions are cancelled automatically.

faqs.question: Is my data encrypted?
faqs.answer: Yes. Data is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.2+ and at rest with AES-256. We never sell personal data.
